prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 41 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1151; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from the side while turning left. The reported mechanism and force are consistent with the cervical strain diagnosed at intake. Care was delivered over 41 visits, consisting of manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. The course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms and range of motion improved. Several examination findings, including limited cervical rotation and paraspinal muscle tenderness, support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and reflex testing were within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, minor strain to the same region in the past that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries.
